title: ElementShot
summary: Capture a visible webpage element or a custom rectangle as a PNG. ElementShot copies it to your clipboard and saves it to Downloads, with flexible parent-and-child selection, padding and filename settings.
stack: TypeScript, Manifest V3, browser screenshot APIs
problem: Capturing a single webpage component can require a manual screenshot and crop.
approach: Select a visible component or draw a custom area, then save and copy a PNG with local browser APIs.
outcome: Version 1.1.0 has downloadable Chrome and Firefox compatibility ZIP packages. Chrome/Edge uses unpacked developer-mode installation; permanent Firefox installation requires signing. Captures are limited to visible viewport pixels. Browser store publication remains separate.
